skills.description: This skill group explains how to review component naming quality in a Form.io JSON file. The reviewer must inspect the input JSON, traverse all relevant top-level and nested components, and evaluate each defined check independently.

This skill group explains how to review Form.io JSON files for unsafe logic execution, missing null/undefined handling, unbounded calculated text output, unsafe required validation on conditionally visible fields, and missing clear-value behavior for approver-edit fields during withdraw or revision flows.

This skill group explains how to review Form.io JSON files for layout structure, top-level wrapper consistency, attachment authorization requirements, logic implementation simplicity, nesting complexity, reusable utility usage, and required platform summary field availability.

This skill group explains how to review Form.io JSON files for unsafe calculated display values, JavaScript runtime errors or Form.io console warnings, and forbidden debug logging statements inside executable logic.
